description: S49 T7 (AN9, TD2) — the agent's ONE ask, answered. automation_propose_disable is a catalog tool and this is its socket twin: the same records service that answers the tool answers the method, so the bytes are the same answer rather than a second rendering of it (rule 4). What the answer is: a PROPOSAL row, `status: proposed`, authored by the AGENT the step belongs to (`createdByKind: agent` — the ask is the model's, and saying so is the audit), carrying WHICH automation (the source is part of the name — AN1), and the agent's reason. The `note` is the fixed inertness statement — `protocol.PolicyProposeInertNote`, one definition in the code and this fixture its wire copy — because an ask constrains nothing: no schedule paused, no trigger switched, nothing is enforced until a person runs the `command` this answer names. An ask that is not a narrowing — an automation already off, unknown, archived — is refused at create by the same door (see propose-disable-refuses-a-smuggled-enabled.json for the door's other half), and there is no propose-enable, -update or -archive ask to file at all: the disable can only take authority away (AN9).
